page.overview:
What is Good Night?

Good Night is the final track on The White Album. Though it was written by John as a lullaby for his son Julian, it was given to Ringo Starr to sing on the album. The master is Take 34, and was put at the end of The Beatles (White Album) for a lush-lullaby-ending. The Anthology 3 version of the song features an additional spoken word introduction by Starr.
